goal: Capture every locally available ReviewCompass3 Codex rollout into the repository-external private archive, reconcile the previously captured rollout, and verify the resulting private artifacts without capturing another project or provider.

supersedes.reason: The Human instruction on 2026-08-10 explicitly expands the authorized Codex capture scope from one rollout to all locally available ReviewCompass3 rollouts. Version 2 remains historical and its fixed Development Policy digest is stale.

authorized_sources.selection_rule: session_meta.payload.cwd resolves to the ReviewCompass3 repository root or one of its descendants

in_scope: verify all fixed source digests and the deterministic source selection before capture
preserve each selected Codex rollout as byte-exact raw outside the repository
generate or regenerate the private verbatim transcript for every selected source
create or update each durable cursor and private provenance record
update the shared integrity ledger without replacing a divergent preserved prefix
repeat the selected-source capture once to absorb the live task growth available at that boundary
verify source-to-raw equality or report the live task tail after capture
verify artifact digests, parse results, permissions, temporary files, and Git boundary
out_of_scope: Codex rollouts whose working directory is outside ReviewCompass3
hook, watcher, scheduler, service, or background automation activation
retention deletion, backup, or application-layer encryption
Git storage of private transcript artifacts
acceptance: all fixed source digests match before capture
the selected relative-path list contains 81 sources and matches the fixed manifest digest
all existing preserved raw files are exact prefixes of their selected sources before update
every selected source reports reconciled without divergence, parse failure, or unsupported source
a second pass reports unchanged except for bytes appended by the live task between passes
stored raw, verbatim, cursor, provenance, and ledger agree after reread
all parsed sources have zero parse issues
private output remains outside the repository with directories 0700 and files 0600
no temporary or lock file remains
no non-ReviewCompass3 or non-Codex source is captured
the final synchronous report states any unavoidable tail added by the live session itself
stop_conditions: the selected source count or manifest digest differs from preflight
an existing archive is not an exact prefix of its source
a selected source does not belong to ReviewCompass3
a private output may enter the repository or Git boundary
the collector reports divergence, parse failure, unsupported source, or artifact checkpoint failure
provider source mutation would be required
the repository worktree changes outside the authority records and result evidence for this operation
recovery: preserve the last valid raw and cursor on write failure
rerun the failed selected source from its durable cursor after interruption
record divergence without overwriting the archive
regenerate derived artifacts from preserved raw
stop and request Human review if the fixed selection changes before capture
